areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Cultural spaces are part of the buildings and one specific objective and indicator relate, but only a few percent of resources and culture is not central; impact minor.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned (smart urban district); specific objective, component and indicator direct; relevant share of resources, but impact moderate because impacts are confined to the site.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: General objective not environmental; specific objective, green-area product and indicator exist, but very small resource share and no efficiency or innovation aspects; impact minor.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: General objective, several specific objectives, component and indicators directly aligned; the largest resource share, high impact but not exceptional; solutions efficient.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Specific objective and training indicator target vulnerable groups, but job creation is an indirect effect and resources are small; impact minor with no efficiency evidence.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: General objective relates to digital transformation, with a relevant specific objective and indicator, but very low resource share; impact minor.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Specific objective and local-supplier indicator, including neighboring areas, are relevant, but general objective unrelated and few resources; impact minor.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Specific objective and indicator on technology services for public bodies are direct, but not central to the general objective; low resource share, minor impact.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Indicator and resources are better aligned to science and innovation and were counted there to avoid double counting, so minimum criteria are not met.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Productivity effects are an indirect consequence of the innovation environment; the specific objective fits innovation, and the company-count indicator does not measure productivity.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Proponent cited its self-sustaining financing model, but financial sustainability is a viability requirement for every project and the area concerns the broader fiscal and tax regime.
